title: The Python Is Born
summary: Medusa's swallowing of the Green Lotus Core Flame seems to fail, and the Snakemen mourn her. Then the energy of heaven and earth surges, breaking every ban in the space, and Gu He's group retreats. Yao Lao shields Xiao Yan through the storm, and the angered Heavenly Flame explodes and burns Medusa's snake body away. From the flames comes a small creature: Medusa's companion spirit, the Quiet Purple Flame Serpent, which has evolved into a Seven-Colored Heaven Swallowing Python. The python has no memory and no wish to kill. Xiao Yan feeds it Amethyst Lion Birth Essence and decides to keep it. He then collects the Green Lotus Core Flame with the Green Colored Lotus Platform, which hides its scent.
